title: ReflektorTTS profile
description: Describes one app: how to recognize it, where to read its text and how to process it.

$schema.description: This schema’s URL, for editors that check and complete profiles: ReflektorTTS ignores it.

title.description: The app’s title, as shown to users.

match.description: How to recognize the running program.

executables.description: The program’s executables: one program can ship several.

name.description: The file name, without folders, e.g. "gta2.exe".

sha256.description: SHA-256 of each supported build of the file, in lowercase hex. Without it, any build with this name matches.

rating.description: How far the profile is tested, as a medal: bronze (some texts read, tried only briefly), silver (the main texts read, tested in the first part of the app), gold (the main texts read, tested through most of the app) or platinum (every text the app shows read, tested through all of it). Without it, the profile is not rated.

overlay.description: Whether the overlay is loaded into the app. Default: false. Needs the executables’ sha256, so the overlay only goes into builds it was tested with.

glossary.description: Words and phrases of the app that translation and speech treat specially, by the input language (two-letter code) their terms are written in, e.g. {"en": [...]}. A line read in another language gets none. Each entry uses "keep", "means" or "pronounce", or several of them.

term.description: The word or phrase as the app writes it, e.g. "Big Smoke", or a list of the ways it writes it, e.g. ["Big Smoke", "Big smoke"]. Each is matched as written, and in capitals in shouted lines.

keep.description: Never translated, e.g. a name that is also a word ("Sweet"). Matched with the same capitals.

female.description: A kept term is a woman’s name, so translation declines it as one. Default: false.

means.description: Plain words in the input language the term is translated as, e.g. "neighborhood" for "hood". Matched in any capitals.

pronounce.description: How the term is pronounced, by output language (two-letter code), e.g. {"pl": "Karl"} for "Carl".

sources.description: Where to read the app’s text. Each source’s other fields are defined by its plugin’s own schema.

name.description: Name of this source within the profile, shown in messages.

stages.description: Processing applied in order to this source’s text. Each stage’s other fields are defined by its plugin’s own schema.

text.description: Whether the stage starts on for the text shown (subtitles). Default: true.

speech.description: Whether the stage starts on for what is spoken. Default: true.
